key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to refresh usage data, in seconds

key.name: proxy-url
key.description: HTTP proxy URL, for example http://localhost:11809. Empty means no proxy.

key.name: prefs-page
key.description: Set by a menu's Settings button so the settings window opens on that service's tab

key.name: display-mode
key.description: 'rings' double ring and percentage. The outer ring is the first limit (5-hour, or Cursor Models) and the inner ring is the second (weekly, or Other Models). 'rings-only' is the double ring alone, 'ring' a single ring and percentage, 'text' percentage, 'bar' a progress bar, 'both' bar and percentage

key.name: panel-window
key.summary: Limit the top bar percentage follows
key.description: 'primary' the first limit, 'secondary' the second limit, 'max' whichever is closer to running out

key.name: show-icon
key.summary: Show the service icon in the top bar

key.name: show-tier
key.summary: Show the plan name in the top bar

key.name: show-additional-limits
key.summary: Show per-model limits in the menu

key.name: folder
key.description: Folder holding the service's sign-in. Empty means the usual place (~/.claude, ~/.codex or ~/.config/Cursor).

key.name: paused-until
key.description: Set when the service asks to check less often. Unix time before which no checks are made.

key.name: last-usage
key.description: Shown, marked out of date, when new numbers can't be fetched
